WORK.meaning: Abstract intellectual work independent of edition, file, scan, or provider.
WORK.id_rule: WORK- + first 32 hex chars of SHA-256 over normalized title|primary creator stable id|original publication year when known; collisions require disambiguation rather than overwrite.

EDITION.meaning: A publication/translation/revision manifestation of a work.
EDITION.id_rule: EDITION- + first 32 hex chars of SHA-256 over work_id|publisher/imprint|publication date|edition statement|translator/editor ids|ISBN or equivalent when present.

SOURCE.meaning: A specific acquired file, URL, API record, scan, user upload, or licensed delivery.
SOURCE.id_rule: SOURCE- + first 32 hex chars of SHA-256 over edition_id|provider|stable locator|content_digest.

PASSAGE.meaning: A bounded segment of an admitted source used only within its rights envelope.
PASSAGE.id_rule: PASSAGE- + first 32 hex chars of SHA-256 over source_id|canonical structural locator|normalized passage digest.

bibliographic: case-fold identifiers only when the identifier standard is case-insensitive
normalization.text_digest: SHA-256 of exact acquired bytes plus a separate SHA-256 of Unicode-NFC text when text decoding is valid

deduplication.exact_duplicate: same exact-byte digest -> one binary payload, multiple provenance edges allowed
deduplication.text_equivalent_duplicate: same normalized-text digest -> retain distinct source/edition provenance but do not multiply training/retrieval weight
deduplication.near_duplicate: MinHash/embedding similarity may nominate candidates only; automatic collapse requires matching work/edition evidence plus deterministic text checks
deduplication.excerpt_overlap: overlapping passages share overlap-group id; evaluation/training splits must keep overlap groups together
deduplication.translation: never deduplicate translations into one text instance; they are edition-level siblings
deduplication.revision: never deduplicate author revisions/editions if wording differs; model them as related editions

group_keys: user_project_id when project text is involved
split_integrity.rule: No evaluation claim may treat passages from the same work/edition/overlap group as unseen if related text appears in training or calibration.
